text.tspan: 400 on a blank query or an
HTTP error status in the flow
A NO-OP for an unknown session — make
it raise and a dead browser crashes
the clock resets on every frame
Frees the SOCKET, never the COMPUTE.
The daemon runs to completion, and
every later emit() no-ops into an
done · error · stream_end are ROUTE-framed, not node-emitted.
close_session() pushes a 2nd sentinel that nobody reads.
